verdict.rationale: A GPU's official software ecosystem (drivers, CUDA Toolkit) could plausibly include an official command-line tool, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents an official CLI for the RTX 5080 or its software. The CUDA Toolkit is described only as including a compiler, libraries, and debugging/optimization tools, with no CLI interface or AI-native command-line workflow mentioned. Those developer building blocks earn no credit for this story.
